$comment: Registers the read-only server over this project's graph for Claude Code in this repo.
The interpreter is named explicitly and is the anaconda python: it is the one on this
machine that has fastmcp, the neo4j driver and pyyaml, which is the same reason
CLAUDE.md names it for extraction and projection. A bare `python3` here would start a
server that cannot import fastmcp and would surface as a connector that failed to
connect, with no message saying why.
The path is absolute for the same reason the Desktop config's paths are: an MCP client
starts the process with a working directory of its own choosing, not this repository's.
